children: Real smoke. Big spreads. Zero fuss.
Low-and-slow BBQ, taco bars and game-day feasts for backyard parties and corporate lunches — catered by folks who actually run the pit.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Brisket, pork and ribs over real wood for twelve-plus hours — never a warming tray of somebody else’s food. You taste the difference.
A backyard of fifteen or a company picnic of five hundred — we scale the spread and bring enough that nobody leaves hungry.
Want it dropped hot and ready? Done. Want us to set up, serve and clean up? Also done. You pick how hands-off you want to be.
One clear price per guest, sides included. No surprise line items, no math the morning of — just a spread that shows up ready.

These days we run a mobile pit and cater the whole region — but the rule hasn’t changed: everything’s smoked fresh the day of your event, by the same crew that started it.

children: We’re a small crew that takes BBQ seriously and takes ourselves not at all. We smoke everything ourselves, over real wood, the day of your event — no shortcuts, no reheated trays.
Backyard party, office lunch, tailgate or a wedding for three hundred — we bring a generous, hearty spread and the kind of easygoing service that makes hosting feel easy.
